meta.description: Items this module's fixed rule marks as unusual. Rule: an economy's latest month is flagged: the move in demand per day from the month before is 2.5 spreads or more from what that calendar month brought in up to ten earlier years.

data.subject: SG
data.sentence: Singapore: 5.5 TWh in August 2026, demand per day up 6.6% on a year earlier; the move from the month before was 2.6 spreads from what that calendar month usually brings.
data.label: observation
data.label_reason: Arithmetic on published monthly figures: demand per day, its change on a year earlier, and how far the latest monthly move is from what that calendar month usually brings. No model is fitted.
